labels.look: White, black section bars, 8 licence-size cards (Mini to Testing) with limits, preview text field, full-series package with price
labels.ux: Pick licence size, type preview text, tick packages/styles, add to cart
labels.learn: Spell out each licence tier in concrete limits (workstations, monthly visitors, apps) so buyers self-select

labels.look: White, dense ASCII-art city (cars, buildings, 'COMPUTERS', 'PHONE') drawn in the font, then mono copyright and OFL notice
labels.learn: Close with a big illustration drawn entirely in the font: the last specimen is also the sign-off

labels.look: Charcoal, default numerals row, arrow with round 'ss04'/'ss05' badge to circled and index-figure rows; cookie banner covers one label
labels.learn: Draw the feature tag as a node on an arrow from default to alternate: reads like a transformation diagram

labels.variantDefinition: Video or photos of a real printed piece (book, flipbook, poster) handled in hands, proving the font in physical print
labels.look: Black frame, caption 'CINEMATOGRAPHY - 16:9 FLIPBOOK', video of hands holding a black flipbook with white type, play button
labels.ux: Play video of the flipbook being thumbed
labels.learn: A flipbook animates the type through print itself: motion and materiality in one object

labels.look: Overlapping vintage hotel/luggage labels ('Auberge Châtelet', 'La Parisienne Boutique', 'Palace Hotel & Resort') in teal, salmon, navy
labels.learn: Faux-ephemera (luggage labels) lets one display face show many lockups, ornaments and colourways at once

labels.look: Black, small white grotesk, 'Credits' heading, four ruled columns: Typeface description and Visuals (website, artist)
labels.learn: Credits can restate the family's facts (cuts, weights, glyph count) as a closing summary

labels.look: Unstyled default HTML: numbered bold headings ('Introducing Yrsa', 'Harmonizing Gujarati and Latin'), one-line blurbs, 'Read more' links
labels.ux: Click 'Read more' to open each process article
labels.learn: A numbered series of process articles turns a font release into a readable design course

labels.look: Cream, four pink-ruled panels (Mono, Semi, Poly, Variable), each style as an olive font-file icon with 'Aa'; sticky ruler nav overlaps
labels.ux: Style cards likely link/download; nav ruler shows scroll position with Type tester, Try, Buy
labels.learn: Drawing each style as a font-file icon makes the family feel like a set of tangible deliverables

labels.variantDefinition: Free download button paired with a plain-language summary of the open licence (what you may and may not do), sometimes with a press kit
labels.look: White, two centred columns: 'Free for all' black Download font button with OFL summary; 'Press kit' outline button and media contact
labels.ux: Download font zip; download PR kit; read full terms
labels.learn: Summarise the OFL in two human sentences next to the button, and give press a separate kit and named contact
